notes.title: We Are Participating In The Upcoming Steam Scream Fest!
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce that we will be participating in the next Scream Fest!!
Try to survive in the haunted castle!

What to expect
[olist]
 Up to 4 people online co-op (1-4)
 A cool ghost to guide you around the castle
 New rooms
 New zombies and enemies
 3 mini bosses (Troll, Spider Queen And Medusa)!
 New bosses skills and AI
 Unique encounters
 Fight The Demon That haunts the castle
[/olist]

Be ready for a new experience!

notes.title: The Beta Continues!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42888589/08d673f9039d8f705a7d8b4ab333664cd78b3afd.png
The beta continues until june!
Registration is still available!
Sign up here : https://angel-games-studio.web.app/

What did we insert in the first few weeks:

[olist]
 Procedural Recoil system!
 Melee combat system
 Interactive lobby with procedural clouds (thunderstorm setting)
 New enemy animations
[/olist]
What to expect in the next few weeks
[olist]
 Spider enemy shooting webs
 Spider enemy walking on the walls and ceiling
 New rooms to explore
 New demon (boss) skills and vfx
[/olist]

Sign up now!
